summary.root_cause_text: The ops config change moved payment_provider_url from internal://payments-v1 to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable. The worker keeps marking orders processed without payment.
recommended: Revert payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v1, or fix connectivity to payments-v2. A human rejected my attempt to revert it.
Then run reprocess_orders with all_unpaid (it never double-charges) and confirm with check_invariants.
Do not restart the worker until payments work again.
